annotations.title: Marriage match between two saved people

description: Marriage compatibility between two saved people: the traditional 36-point Guna Milan (Ashtakoota) with all 8 parts and their cancellations, and the Manglik check for both, from their saved kundlis (bride/groom order follows the saved genders). Use when the user asks whether two saved people are compatible, about a match for a son or daughter, or about Manglik dosha between them. Read-only. Only for people saved on the user's AstroCalc account (needs a free AstroCalc sign-in); birth details typed in the chat work without sign-in in free_kundli, kundli_milan, explain_dasha, full_chart and life_timeline.

lang.description: Language of the text fields: 'en' (English, default) or 'hi' (Hindi).
